title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 30: Hezekiah calls all Israel and Judah to Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

questions.text: Where did Hezekiah call all Israel and Judah to come to keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah sent to all Israel and Judah that they should come to Yahweh's house at Jerusalem to keep the Passover to Yahweh.

questions.text: In which month did the king and the assembly decide to keep the Passover?
questions.explanation: The king had taken counsel with his princes and all the assembly in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.

questions.text: Why could they not keep the Passover at that time?
questions.explanation: They could not keep it then, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered to Jerusalem.

answers.text: An Assyrian army was camped around the walls of Jerusalem
Too few priests were sanctified and the people had not gathered
The temple had been burned to the ground by enemies
There were no lambs or goats left anywhere in the land

questions.text: How did people in the country of Ephraim and Manasseh, even to Zebulun, treat the couriers?
questions.explanation: As the couriers passed from city to city, people ridiculed them and mocked them.

answers.text: They welcomed them with a feast
They stoned them at the city gate

questions.text: Men of which tribes humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Some men of Asher, Manasseh, and Zebulun humbled themselves and came to Jerusalem.

questions.text: Where did they throw the altars for incense that were in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They took away all the altars for incense and threw them into the brook Kidron.

questions.text: What did Yahweh do after Hezekiah prayed for the people who were not clean?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah prayed for those who ate the Passover without being cleansed, and Yahweh listened to Hezekiah and healed the people.

answers.text: He sent a plague on the assembly
He sent the people back to their cities
He listened to Hezekiah and healed the people
He struck the Levites with leprosy

questions.text: After the seven days of the feast, what did the whole assembly decide?
questions.explanation: The whole assembly took counsel to keep another seven days, and they kept another seven days with gladness.

answers.text: To march against the king of Assyria
To build a new altar in Jerusalem

questions.text: What did Hezekiah give to the assembly for offerings?
questions.explanation: Hezekiah king of Judah gave to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep.

answers.text: One hundred bulls and seven hundred sheep
Seven thousand bulls and one thousand sheep
One thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep
Two thousand bulls and twelve thousand sheep

questions.text: Since whose time had there been nothing like this joy in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: There was great joy in Jerusalem, for since the time of Solomon the son of David king of Israel there was nothing like this in Jerusalem.
